capabilities: convert pasted png, jpg and jpeg images to jpeg format
compress pasted images with a configurable quality setting
store pasted images in an images folder next to the current note
rename pasted images to the note name plus a number, e.g. hello-1.jpeg
extras: README is short and appears machine-translated; it does not cover settings beyond compression on/off and quality.
intentEvidence: inspired by obsidian-paste-image-rename, obsidian-paste-image-rename can be used when inserting images rename
motivation: The author was using obsidian-paste-image-rename for renaming pasted images and thought compression and format conversion could also happen at paste time.
problem: Obsidian saves pasted PNG screenshots as-is, which produces large files with generic names in the vault.

relations.evidence: This plugin is inspired by obsidian-paste-image-rename

summary: Paste handler that converts pasted PNG screenshots to JPEG, compresses them, stores them in an images folder, and renames them after the note.
